name: Apothecary optional Winds of Magic Career
conversion: Optional one-time second roll after the core Career result. Keep the original by choice or if the result is unavailable to the Species, following the existing user-approved policy. Wizard 01–95 retains core Wizard with a choice of the eight printed Human College Careers; no artificial probabilities are assigned to that choice.
